summary.text: Beth Lear is a member of the Ohio House of Representatives, representing District 61, which covers eastern Delaware County and western Knox County. Her official biography says she is serving her second term and previously worked as a legislative aide in the Ohio House and in education policy.

paragraphs.text: The House biography says Lear graduated from Olentangy High School and earned a bachelor's degree in international relations from The Ohio State University.
It says she served in the Ohio Air National Guard, including active duty at the Pentagon during Operation Desert Storm.

According to the biography, Lear worked as a legislative aide in the Ohio House, as education policy analyst and legislative liaison for the Buckeye Institute, and most recently as vice president of government affairs for Associated Builders and Contractors of Ohio.

It says she has served on the Delaware County Republican Central Committee since 2011 and has been a board member of the Delaware County Library, the Delaware County Port Authority and four charter schools.
The biography says she has been married to her husband, Jeff, for over 30 years, that they live in Galena, and that they have two adult children.
